rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something in a suitable or proper way.

example.english: You need to arrange your time appropriately so you can finish it.
example.traditional: 你要適當咁安排時間，先至做得完。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 sik1 dong3 gam2 on1 paai4 si4 gaan3 sin1 zi3 zou6 dak1 jyun4

rows.note: Use this when behavior, wording, or appearance is socially appropriate and well-mannered.

example.english: They respond appropriately, and the elders all feel comfortable.
example.traditional: 佢得體咁回應，長輩都覺得舒服。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dak1 tai2 gam2 wui4 jing3 coeng4 bui3 dou1 gok3 dak1 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use this colloquial construction when saying that an action was done the right or suitable way.

example.english: You handled it appropriately this time, so nobody had any objections.
example.traditional: 你今次處理得啱，大家都冇意見。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 ci3 cyu2 lei5 dak1 ngaam1 daai6 gaa1 dou1 mou5 ji3 gin3
